scientific_limitations: Deterministic two-homogeneous-island, zero-self-weight, bias-exponent-one model only; no within-island heterogeneity or stochastic meetings.
The intermediate demographic interval contains a polarized local basin; no complete global basin classification is asserted.
Critical asymptotic holds at fixed homophily and fixed target level; no uniformity as homophily tends to one.
Historical priority is provisionally assessed against inspected records only; no independent external validation.
title: Demographic takeover and inverse-seed delay in a two-island biased-assimilation model
